note: Pinned Maven closures for the opt-in Android modules (akanjs readiness O8): FCM for the push plugin, Play Billing for iap. Resolved like Gradle (highest version wins, Gradle module metadata where published); every file is checked against its SHA-256. The kotlin-stdlib family is left out: akan-native's own kotlin-stdlib replaces it. Research: docs/research/android-aar-closure.md. androidx.core:core:1.10.0 is a root of every closure with FCM: play-services-basement 18.9.0 calls PendingIntentCompat (core 1.10.0+) but declares core 1.2.0, and the rest of the FCM graph resolves core only to 1.9.0.
